input.unflaggedText: The quarterly review went smoothly this time. Every department submitted their numbers on time, which almost never happens. The finance team highlighted a small overspend in travel costs, but nothing alarming. Marketing reported a modest increase in qualified leads compared to last quarter. Engineering finished two of the three planned features and pushed the third to next sprint. Everyone agreed the meeting could have been thirty minutes shorter. Afterward, a few of us grabbed coffee and talked about weekend plans instead of work for a change, which felt like a nice way to close out the week.
